jobs.subject: Happy New Month — a little reminder for your parenting journey
jobs.bodyText:
Happy New Month 💜

We’ve stepped into a new month — and a new quarter.

Before the year runs away with us, this may be a good time to pause and reflect on your parenting journey so far.

What has gone well?
What has felt hard?
What have you been learning about yourself, your children and your family?
What would you like to be more intentional about in the months ahead?

And if you have reached a point where you are thinking, “God has to help me with this,” I understand.

Because I can’t even lie — parenting is very spiritual. We need God’s wisdom, strength, help and grace.

In case you didn’t know, at Lit Lambs we pray together every first Saturday of the month at 6:00 AM WAT. It is simply a time to seek God intentionally about our parenting journey, our children and our families.

This Saturday, October 3, we’ll be praying again.

If you’d like to join us, use the link below to join the WhatsApp group. The prayer details will be shared there:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/IXpA5Q0IHx25cUTyqqoxjs?s=cl&p=i&mlu=4&ilr=4

Happy New Month. I pray October brings you fresh grace, wisdom and strength for your family.

Lesi
Founder, Lit Lambs
